_comment: Committed persistence declaration per module (a decision, not a measurement); read by tools/cardmeta_footprint.py, which adds sizes and counts from the live state. Paths: repo-relative, absolute or ~/...; <project> is replaced by the project name; kind 'dir' counts files. 'volume': true marks files whose modification times feed the volume figures. A missing backup or retention statement is a gap and is shown as such: gaps below are honest 'undocumented' entries, not decisions. Backup 'undocumented' means nobody has decided yet (the cockpit shows it as a gap); the code itself is in git.

files.note: access token created with --token-file (mode 0600); a secret, not personal data; the path is the documented default, the owner may choose another

logging.rotation: none: the logger writes to standard error, no log file; the request log hides the token

policy.backup: code: the git repository and its remote; runtime state is a rebuildable cache and the token file is a secret: not backed up on purpose
policy.retention: in-memory cache: lives with the process, entries refresh after 60 to 3600 seconds (cached() in cockpit.py); token file: kept until the owner deletes it, no rotation in the code; no database

policy.backup: the page: the git repository and its remote; browser storage is not backed up on purpose
policy.retention: browser localStorage only, never sent anywhere: key cockpit-project (selected project) and cockpit-reviewed:<repo> (review state of rule changes); kept until the user clears site data

policy.backup: the git repository and its remote; nothing else to back up
policy.retention: kept until the owner deletes them (git history)

files.note: screenshots made by tools/shots.py; they show whatever the cockpit showed, so check before publishing

policy.backup: the git repository and its remote; nothing else to back up
policy.retention: kept until the owner deletes them (git history)

files.note: footprint.json, churn.json, ambiguity.json: generated, overwritten at each run, never committed; names, counts and sizes only

logging.rotation: none: the collectors write to standard error, no log file

policy.backup: map and collectors: the git repository and its remote; generated card data is not backed up on purpose (the collectors regenerate it)
policy.retention: only the latest run is kept (files are replaced); no history
